subject: Portfolio Overview – North America Information Technology Exposure
body:
Dear Mr. Kim,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to share an observation from your portfolio review. Currently, 29.7% of your overall wealth is allocated to North America information technology, spread across two positions within one instrument type.

I would welcome the opportunity to meet with you at your convenience to discuss this allocation in the context of your broader portfolio and objectives. Please let me know a date and time that would suit you, and I will arrange accordingly.

Best regards,
[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
